ruling_note: In as an express-line exception on Jeffrey's ruling of 19 Oct 2026 05:10 UTC (definition 9.5): a suburban railway (市域（郊）铁路) run under Ningbo Rail Transit's numbering and fares, like Shanghai Line 16 and Dalian Line 12. It fails T5 as written: every 15 min at weekday peaks and weekend daytime (7.5 min Friday 15:30-17:30), 20 min otherwise.
operator: Ningbo Rail Transit Group (宁波市轨道交通集团有限公司)
notes: China's first cross-sea suburban railway (国内首条跨海市域（郊）铁路), crossing Xiangshan Harbour to Xiangshan County; opened 22 Sep 2026 10:30; 2 underground and 8 elevated stations; 61.45 km (61.5 km in gmw.cn). First and last trains 06:30 and 21:20; weekday-peak express trains stop only at Dancheng. Full-line fare 10 yuan on the network's distance scale. national_mode 市域快轨 inferred from the sources' 市域（郊）铁路. Power supply and gauge not stated in the sources.
